translation: The great method of diagnosis is first to clarify the strength or weakness of the constitution and the ashen or tender quality of the complexion, then to inquire into the daily life and the cause of the illness. If the disease is recent and the body is firm and the constitution substantial, one may follow the previous method. If the disease is chronic with weakened qi and failing spirit, even with abdominal pain and tenesmus one should examine carefully and must not apply the methods of attacking accumulations and clearing-seizing indiscriminately.

Dysentery with lockjaw that cannot take in water and grain all comes from heat rising and turbidity attacking. One must use the greatly bitter Qin, Lian, and Shilian to clear heat, and Renshen to assist the stomach and benefit the qi. Once the hot qi opens, one can at once take food; the medicine should be given frequently for two or three days.
Heat disease is most common in children because the body belongs to pure yang, and when the six qi touch a person's qi and blood they all transform into heat.
